root_cause.text: The IMA filesystem initialization code in `create_securityfs_measurement_lists()` uses `hash_algo_name[algo]` without checking if `algo` (the TPM bank's `crypto_id`) is `HASH_ALGO__LAST`, which indicates an unsupported algorithm, causing an out-of-bounds read when the index exceeds the valid hash algorithm names array.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds explicit checks for `algo == HASH_ALGO__LAST` and constructs alternative file names using the raw TPM algorithm ID. The KASAN report and commit description confirm the out-of-bounds access at `hash_algo_name[]` due to an unsupported TPM algorithm (SHA3-256) with `crypto_id` set to `HASH_ALGO__LAST`.

intent_record.how: Prevents out-of-bounds access to hash_algo_name array when algo equals the sentinel HASH_ALGO__LAST, which indicates an unrecognized TPM hash algorithm; instead, the file name includes the raw TPM algorithm ID.
